Overview

Petrovac is a city in Budva with a population of 1,500. A charming seaside resort on the Budva Riviera, known for its red sandy beaches, olive groves, and the nearby ancient fortress of Kastio. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables.
